title: F06 — Upload (single PUT)
tagline: files under 5 MB reach storage through a background URLSession, survive suspension, and get a server-confirmed hash. Large files and resume are F07.
intro: Sprint S3 · 36h · skeleton guide — full code is added when this feature starts.
Code in this guide is a teaching example. Check current source and follow F00 localization rules before applying it.

blocks.html:
• Goal: files under 5 MB reach storage through a background URLSession, survive suspension, and get a server-confirmed hash. Large files and resume are F07.
  • Demo — offline: airplane mode → captures wait on the Sync tab with a plain reason; nothing is red.
  • Demo — signed in: network back → photos upload; kill the app mid-way → they still finish; the server's hash matches.
  • Spec: 04 Upload engine, 03-backend §3, §6, §7.3
  • Starts from: F02 (HTTPClient, token) and F05 (hashed media files).
  • Steps: How every feature runs. Upload talks to its own endpoints, so step 7 swaps the transport, not a sync table.

blocks.html:
Overview

  • Goal: the coordinator's transport becomes a background URLSession; a pure state machine decides every retry. Split into tasks: session · state machine · backoff.
  • Spec: 04.3, 04.4
ActionFileHolds
NewUploadKit/BackgroundSessionDelegate.swiftSession delegate
NewUploadKit/UploadCoordinator.swiftActor, the only executor of effects
NewUploadKit/UploadStateMachine.swiftEvents → (state, effects); no I/O
NewUploadKit/PresignedURLProvider.swiftBegin and complete through HTTPClient
EditApp/AppDelegate.swift, App/DI/PlatformDI.swifthandleEventsForBackgroundURLSession; register the coordinator
  • Check: a real device uploads 20 photos with the screen locked; the repository did not change.

Steps

  1. isDiscretionary = false, sessionSendsLaunchEvents = true; enqueue the first batch in the foreground.
  2. 401/403 and offline consume no retry budget.
  3. Delay min(2s × 2^n, 300s) × jitter, max 5 attempts; inject the RNG.
